scope.owned_layer: Supervisor policy that reaps stale blocking L12 missing_process failure streaks before reassignment/chair triage and on direct or self-claim dispatch paths.
not_changing: generic quota or authentication failure handling

eligibility: Task id begins with L12- or SUP-L12-.
Streak count meets the configured chair failure-loop threshold.
The failed logical lane is the current owner for owned/finalize states or current reviewer for review.
The task last_update is strictly newer than the streak last_failure_at.
No matching active worker or pending delivery exists for the task and logical lane.
integration_points: _run_once_locked invokes the reaper after worker polling and before failure-streak reassignment or chair failure-loop triage.
dispatch_ready_tasks invokes the same idempotent policy before computing failure-loop exclusions, covering direct dispatch and worker self-claim.
fail_closed_exclusions: Quota, auth, terminal, transient, and generic failures
Streaks for a lane no longer assigned to the task
Task/lane pairs with active or pending runtime evidence

acceptance.criterion: Reproduce the stale L12 missing_process streak blocker.
acceptance.proof: Dispatcher regressions seed above-threshold stale streaks that previously entered failure_loop_task_ids and suppressed owner, helper, or reviewer dispatch.

acceptance.criterion: Add a bounded reaper or eligibility check.
acceptance.proof: The reaper applies six fail-closed predicates and removes at most four records per cycle; the bounded regression leaves the fifth eligible record intact.

acceptance.criterion: Prove Claude2/Antigravity dispatch before Codex-family fallback.
acceptance.proof: One regression offers Codex2 before Claude2 and observes only Claude2 owner dispatch; one seeds a review-stage Claude2 reviewer blocker and observes review_ready_dispatch; another offers Codex2 before Antigravity with Claude2 paused and observes only the next preferred Antigravity helper claim.

known_limitations: The policy does not claim current Claude2 or Antigravity provider readiness; readiness remains governed by live provider probes.
The policy does not clear a fresh process-loss loop merely because no process is alive.
This repository change does not mutate the current live runtime state or provider configuration.
